patterns.note: The site uses a high-contrast, full-width layout with distinct sections, often featuring large typographic elements as primary visual anchors.
Hero and section titles employ an extremely bold, wide sans-serif typeface, often in all caps, creating a strong, impactful visual statement.
A stark black and white palette is consistently used for text and backgrounds, punctuated by a vibrant, saturated orange for calls to action and footer sections.

The initial hero section undergoes a dramatic transformation on scroll: a complex grid of images and text collapses to reveal a minimalist, oversized typographic hero (the artist's name) which then scrolls away to reveal the main content. The navigation also shrinks and repositions to become a compact sticky header.
Content is organized into clearly delineated sections with bold, uppercase headings, often using a simple grid or list format for details like tour dates or gallery items.

technique_notes: The hero section implements a complex scroll-triggered transformation where an initial busy visual composition is replaced by a minimalist, large-scale typographic display, which then scrolls out of view. This involves elements fading, scaling, and repositioning based on scroll depth.
The primary navigation bar dynamically changes its size and layout on scroll, transitioning from a larger, more spread-out initial state to a compact, sticky version at the top of the viewport.
Content sections utilize full-bleed imagery and video, sometimes with a semi-transparent color overlay (e.g., green) to create visual interest and unify design.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, bold sans-serif hero text (~8x body) with smaller, clean sans-serif for navigation and body text, and large, bold section headings.
design_tokens.radius: sharp — all elements feature crisp, angular corners.
design_tokens.spacing: airy — generous vertical spacing between major sections, with content within sections maintaining a balanced density.

standout: The most distinctive feature is the dramatic, multi-stage hero transformation on scroll. It transitions from a busy, collage-like introduction to a stark, oversized typographic statement, effectively using motion to control focus and reveal content in a highly dynamic way.
